artists.biography:
James Patrick "Jimmy" Page, OBE (born 9 January 1944) is an English guitarist, songwriter, and record producer. He began his career as a studio session guitarist in London and was subsequently a member of The Yardbirds from 1966 to 1968, after which he founded the English rock band Led Zeppelin.
Jimmy Page is viewed by critics, fans and fellow musicians alike as one of the most influential and important guitarists and songwriters in rock music. Rolling Stone magazine has described him as "the pontiff of power riffing & probably the most digitally sampled artist in pop today after James Brown." In 2010, Jimmy Page was ranked number two in Gibson's list of "Top 50 Guitarists of All Time" and, in 2007, number four on Classic Rock Magazine's "100 Wildest Guitar Heroes". Page was ranked third in Rolling Stone magazine's list of the "100 Greatest Guitarists of All Time" in 2011. He has been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame twice; once as a member of The Yardbirds (1992), and once as a member of Led Zeppelin (1995).

artists.biography:
The Black Crowes are an American rock band formed in 1989. Their discography includes nine studio albums, four live albums and several charting singles. The band was signed to Def American Recordings in 1989 by producer George Drakoulias and released their debut album, Shake Your Money Maker, the following year. The follow-up, The Southern Harmony and Musical Companion, reached the top of the Billboard 200 in 1992.

After a hiatus between 2002 and 2005, the band released Warpaint, which hit number 5 on the Billboard chart. After the release of a double album, the greatest hits-like and mostly acoustic Croweology in August 2010, the band started a 20th anniversary tour that was followed by an ongoing second hiatus.

The band has opened for various rock acts such as Heart, Robert Plant, Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, the Dave Matthews Band, the Grateful Dead, Aerosmith and ZZ Top, and performed live with Jimmy Page and Oasis, among others. The band has sold over 30 million albums, and is listed at number 92 on VH1's "100 Greatest Artists of Hard Rock". They were also labeled by Melody Maker as "The Most Rock 'n' Roll Rock 'n' Roll Band in the World" and the readers of Rolling Stone voted them 'Best New American Band' in 1990.

Live At The Greek is a live album by Jimmy Page, recorded with The Black Crowes during performances at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles on October 18 and 19, 1999, and originally released in 2000. The album showcases a blend of classic rock styles, primarily rooted in Led Zeppelin’s legacy, as The Black Crowes, heavily influenced by Zeppelin, join Page in performing a setlist that includes Led Zeppelin classics and covers. The musical style is characterized by powerful guitar work from Page combined with the blues-rock energy and soulful vocals of The Black Crowes, creating a dynamic live rock experience that bridges generations of rock music.

In the context of Jimmy Page’s discography, Live At The Greek stands out as a notable collaboration that captures the guitarist revisiting his iconic Led Zeppelin material in a live setting with a contemporary band that respects and channels his musical roots. It followed the release of Led Zeppelin compilation albums in 1999 and offered fans a fresh live interpretation of Zeppelin songs, though initially limited by contractual issues that excluded Black Crowes originals from the original release. Critically, the album was well-received for its energetic performances and the chemistry between Page and The Black Crowes, though it remained somewhat niche compared to Page’s studio work or Led Zeppelin’s original recordings. Commercially, it was released both digitally and as a two-disc retail set, appealing to dedicated fans of classic rock and live recordings.

In 2025, the album was expanded and remastered, restoring previously unreleased Black Crowes tracks and additional live performances, further cementing its significance as a document of this unique collaboration and enhancing its appeal for collectors and new listeners alike. The album was originally released under the label MusicMaker.com and later by TVT Records, with The Orchard involved in subsequent releases. It remains an important live record that highlights Jimmy Page’s enduring influence and the Black Crowes’ role in carrying forward the rock tradition.
